moodys.citation_text: Moody's downgraded UC Health to A3 stable in 2020 (early in year, before window snapshot date). A3 was the held rating at 2020-12-31.

sp.citation_text: S&P held A but revised outlook from Stable to Negative in 2020. A/Negative was the held rating at 2020-12-31.

fitch.citation_text: UC Health not rated by Fitch.

outcome_class_rationale: UC Health entered window with A3/A and S&P negative outlook. Both ratings held flat through 2022 — the well-known two-notch downgrades occurred in Feb 2023 (S&P to BBB+) and May 2023 (Moody's to Baa3), AFTER the 2022-12-31 window cutoff. Within window, no rating actions, but the negative outlook flagged credit concerns that DID materialize 2023+. CARES Act stimulus and $208M April 2020 bond issuance grew liquidity to $921M, providing cushion through window.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: UC Health grew unrestricted cash to $921M in 2020 thanks to stimulus and $208M bond. Revenue ~$1.75B based on multi-year trajectory (current $3.9B vs. 2020 pre-growth). _warning: revenue estimate; cash and debt figures more reliable.

ma_events_2021_2022.rationale: $208M bond issuance April 2020 to bolster liquidity during COVID. _warning: technically just before window snapshot but useful context.
